summary: Persistent live runtime: 17-step loop with approvals, waiting, limits, crash-safe resume; structured logs with redaction; journal; task loader and three task files; independent membership / metric verifiers with signing, hash-chained log and service; operator control; multi-actor plumbing; dashboard; doctor; preflight; cam-live CLI; learner process entry. G-rt verification (docs/verification/G_rt.md) found 1 critical, 11 major and 13 minor defects; all 25 were fixed with regression tests (docs/F/FIXES.md): every rt probe reports HOLDS for the fixed properties; the checks still reported BROKEN encode the old design (p05 1a, p09 1b: 16 REQUIRED items; p08 6, 8; p11 14) or an inherent limit (p02 --no-dedup over-counts an interrupted action by its estimate: 6 of 477). The integrated agent (cam_live.agent, by M) now exists and its runtime integration tests pass with this runtime; cam_live.eval.transfer is still absent.

AE-06.limitations: Exercised with two LabWorld actors and a small ridge learner; an unreachable central learner is recorded as an error of the cycle (and pauses the actor after max_consecutive_errors), it no longer raises out of step(). The RPC learner endpoint carries JSON payloads over a unix socket only; the integrated agent must implement export_experience / weights_version / set_weights to take part.

CU-24.limitations: Evidence that arrives without a scheduled wake is only seen at the configured evidence poll interval (the environment contract has no push channel). Learner-defined prediction queries are measured for actions that happened, at most 16 per decision and 2000 pending. INT2: RuntimeConfig.drain_after_exhaustion (S-1, opt-in): after the decision budget the run keeps measuring and verifying without deciding until a terminal verdict or the deadline; outcomes still pending when an objective completes are not measured.

LX-01.limitations: 16 items are marked REQUIRED for the operator (the evidence source now defaults to cam_live.harness.discord_membership:membership_source for a task with Discord resources and is named in the file). The success block, exclusions and measurement protocol go to the verifier; the learner receives runtime.tasks.learner_view.

commands: .venv/bin/python cam_live/docs/verification/repro/rt/p05_tasks.py  (1 of 33 broken: 1a hardcodes 17 REQUIRED items, there are 16)
LX-02.limitations: Closed schema (unknown keys anywhere rejected with their path), bounded free text, YAML anchors / aliases / duplicate keys refused, mechanical strategy scan of every free text and free-form key; objective text with strategy-like content needs objective_confirmation: sha256:<hash of the text>. The text scan is heuristic (regular expressions): prose that avoids every pattern in a free-text field (objective, success.definition, measurement.protocol) can still pass. The runtime process reads the full task file (the authorization service pins the task by its content hash); only the learner object is limited to learner_view. INT3B round 2 (G2R-1): keys and values are scanned as a reader sees them (NFKC, invisible / direction characters removed, identifiers split on separators and camelCase); invisible characters are refused in identifiers and keys (probe_tasks_disguise 14/14 hold). Still heuristic. INT3B round 3 (G2R-1b): confusable skeleton (TR39-style), leetspeak folding, spelled-out letters joined, concatenated words split over a word list, mixed-script words flagged, listing / bump sites and outreach moves (probe_tasks_disguise 23/23: 18 variants refused). False refusals: none on the 6 task files of the repository and 141 identifiers of the code base. Still heuristic: a disguise outside these readings and word lists can pass.

LX-03.limitations: Membership rules: per-id merging, case-insensitive flags, link keys tainted by excluded accounts, unknown join time / account age uncertain; achieved only when the lower confidence bound reaches the target. The Discord membership source (harness.discord_membership, master-owned) is the default for Discord tasks; F made no Discord API call. Deleting the last log entry together with the head file stays undetectable (unkeyed chain). INT3B round 2 (G2R-2): only members who joined at / after the experiment's start count (window_start_ts, else the verifier's first reading; a count-only baseline is logged); probe_verifier_live_source A holds. INT3B round 3 (G2R-2b): keyed hashes of the members present at the start (verifier state only, 0600) exclude members who leave and rejoin (probe A2 holds).

The Discord check was tested with stand-in handles only; against the real executor it runs in the supervisor of cam-live run and contacts discord.com. INT3B round 2 (G2R-10): environment / provenance labels and local addresses are recognised in any spelling (probe_preflight 7/7); doctor's disk check uses storage.min_free_gb / warn_free_gb.

LX-13.limitations: A record holds the Decision as the learner produced it plus the runtime's situation digest; rationale and diagnostics are whatever the learner put in the Decision.

LX-14.limitations: Every execution (also of approved actions) is preceded by the limit checks; money uses the larger of the learner's and the tool's estimate, so an action whose actual cost exceeds both overshoots by that action. Learning calls get at most the remaining compute. Invalid limits fail closed. authorization_revoked recognises revocation from the authorization service's reason text (change request F-9). INT2: below storage.min_free_gb the runtime writes no checkpoint and pauses with a resource obstacle; keep_checkpoints 2, optimizer state only in the newest. INT3B round 2: every external step of a program counts and a program is not started at the limit (G2R-5, probe_limits_program 3/3; a program started below the limit can overshoot by its own steps only as far as the authorization service's per-step ledger allows); L- refusals are resource_limit (G2I-14, p07 4/4); export-checkpoint and plan-report check the storage guard first (p03 10/11; check 4 is the agent's export_weights, change request INT3B-8). INT3B round 3: G2R-15 the verifier follows the operator's signed change of the objective in force (deadline, target; probe_next_objective E1 holds); a program whose external steps do not fit into what is left is not started (probe_limits_program 4 holds; its check 3 now reports the decision budget as what ends that scenario).

LX-15.limitations: Kill tests use LabWorld served over the project RPC (F's test agent and G's stand-in); M's integration tests run the same kill -9 restart with the integrated agent. Without environment de-duplication an interrupted action's effect is unknown: it is booked at its estimate (can over-count by one action, never under-count). The journal and the exact resume state are sealed with a per-run key in <run_dir>/learner/. INT2: the runtime only looks at grants (check_grant(consume=False) where the signature names it); the executor consumes (M-int-6); separated-services staging run with 0 grant refusals (docs/evidence/validation/separated/separated_20261127T183623Z.json). INT3B round 2 (G2I-15): the grant issued at the operator's approval is relayed with the signed notice and used, so the action's budget is not reserved twice (an operator tool that does not relay it still re-authorizes: change request INT3B-6); an approval refused at re-authorization is reported with the service's rule and reason. G2R-13: with --no-dedup p02 over-counts in 6 of 477 checks (G2-runtime's measurement), not 4: the two extra rows are the 30000-byte file-size-limit lifetime (money 16.4 vs 16.1, external actions 15 vs 14) - the same disclosed mechanism.
